topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines the focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Principles of innate immune recognition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational concepts of how the innate immune system distinguishes danger and self from non-self using molecular patterns and hardwired receptors.

topics.label: Pattern recognition receptor families and intracellular activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the major classes of pattern recognition receptors, their signaling mechanisms, and the assembly of the inflammasome complex.

topics.label: Inflammatory response, cell trafficking, and systemic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how sentinel cell activation directs leukocyte recruitment, lymphatic drainage, and systemic inflammatory pathology such as sepsis.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic persistence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the mechanisms that shut down inflammation, rebuild damaged tissue, and manage long-term chronic or contained infections.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic closes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on the complement system.
